$comment: Per-component versions for the tools surface — the shell the email signature creator and the
employee ID card generator share, redesigned 1-3 Oct 2026 (decisions in skills/gushwork-tools/decisions.md).
version = the plugin version in which that component's spec last changed.
breaking = true when a build using it renders WRONG until updated.
ONLY WHAT IS NEW IS HERE. The tools reuse the library's own switch, tab group, dropdown, field and
button, and those are not registered again. Each entry below is a pattern the library did not have;
its numbers come from web/internal/tool-shell.css, where every value is a token and anything chosen
rather than measured is marked CHOSEN. There is no Figma node: the shell was built in code.
Review state lives in the sibling `review` block, written by scripts/review-pass.sh. check-drift.sh
reads only ["components"], so that block is inert to it.

tool-panel.note: The floating, collapsible panel a tool keeps its controls in, headed by the blue Gushwork logo tile. Collapsed, it folds to its own header.

tool-action-pill.note: The one floating pill of a tool's actions: views, Download, and the single strong control.

tool-chrome.note: Appearance, Help and the signed-in profile (the hub mark, name, role, Sign out), top-right; plus the logo tile menu.

tool-progress.note: How a long job reports beside the control it belongs to: spinner, percentage, Done, Failed.

tool-saved-list.note: The right panel of a file-keeping tool: file name and status, Save and Copy link, a Download section (type, quality, pages), the rest behind a ⋯ menu.

tool-files-home.note: A file-keeping tool's home, after Google Docs: pill search, a template band (blank + templates), recent files with owner filter, sort and grid / list.

tool-page-strip.note: The page strip under the sheet: numbered live thumbnails, add, duplicate, delete with a confirm, drag to reorder.
